thread:
tara: Postmortem is up for the authz hiccup. Root cause: token validation race + perm-map rollback. Audit sink missed ~4m during the rollback. Link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/292000
sre-bot: Incident created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2920004321 — P2 postmortem
tara: Follow-ups: (1) token validation tests + CI gating, (2) perm-map deploy guard, (3) audit-sink heartbeat + alerting, (4) secrets TTL scan. Please pick owners and ETAs.
ben: I'll take (1). Plan: small harness + GH action. ETA 7 business days. Will include expired-token and concurrent-rotate cases.
elsa: I'll own (3). Add producer heartbeat + missing-event alert if gap >1m. ETA 4 business days.
security: I'll cover (4) secrets TTL scan. Will add k8s CronJob + Prometheus metric `secrets_ttl_drift_total` and a PD rule. ETA 5 business days.
tara: I'll do (2) perm-map guard. Prototype pre-deploy check to block diffs for admin roles. ETA 6 business days.
ben: Question — run harness in PRs or nightly? I vote PR smoke + nightly replay.
tara: Agreed. Add `--nightly` flag for heavy replays.
elsa: Creating tracker: https://redwood.internal/trackers/AUTHZ-2920 and linking tasks.
sre-bot: Noted pattern: audit gaps + secrets drift seen in multiple incidents; recommend weekly telemetry and monthly regression report.
tara: Good. Owners, link PRs and tracker items to this thread. We'll meet in two weeks to confirm closure.
